runs.rejection_summary: Both researched candidates cleared the Thriller profile's 62-point minimum after explicit revelation-cadence research. Black Bag qualified through a sustained mole hunt with repeated suspicion shifts; Drop qualified through frequent new information, suspect narrowing, technology-driven surveillance and a brisk contained cat-and-mouse structure. No duplicates or rejection cases were encountered.

Researched three candidates against the static baseline profile. Two accepted: Bodies (85), a four-timeline murder investigation whose revelations keep recontextualising each other, and Reptile (75), strong on evidence work and institutional corruption though it sags in the middle. The Fall was rejected: it names its killer in the first hour and replaces mystery with a slow pursuit, firing slow_investigation_without_payoff - the guardrail written for exactly this shape - and it does not clear the DNA Match floor. Values were revised down where reviews contradicted the premise. Personalization is dormant: no personalized-scores.json exists and none was created. Zero duplicates against the identity set.

Run Away was accepted at 82 after explicit whole-series revelation-cadence research: reviews describe shocking revelations, complex lies, taut pacing and a dense twist structure, and ending coverage confirms multiple discoveries that repeatedly reframe the family and murder mystery. 56 Days was rejected at a computed 59: it has real twists and uncertainty, but critics repeatedly describe the mystery as snoozy/overlong and the romance-drama component is dominant enough that the baseline DNA score remains below the Thriller minimum of 62. Personalization remains dormant because data/personalized-scores.json is absent. No duplicates were found in the fresh final identity checks.

His & Hers was accepted at 78 after explicit whole-season revelation-cadence research. Across six episodes the murder investigation repeatedly changes the suspect picture through new murders, identity revelations, planted evidence and back-half reversals; reviews describe the run as tight and twisty while also noting that some major reveals are withheld late, so progressive_revelation and revelation_frequency were kept at 7 rather than inflated. Personalization remains dormant because data/personalized-scores.json is absent. No duplicates were found in the fresh final identity check.

The series contains investigation and painful new context, but it does not keep delivering the kind of repeated mystery answers and substantive reframing this profile requires, so no full DNA candidate was advanced to scoring.
